summary: VEILFALL: Ashes of the Nine is an isometric action RPG whose shared main place contains the Z01 road, hub and chapter encounters; a solo Veil place hosts the character/menu flow. World templates attach the Bladewraith and HUD, while the main referee, player, enemy/boss scripts and shared character/data modules divide moment-to-moment state and progression.
places: places/main/ - shared Z01 adventure; sim.js owns quest stages, NPCs, pack and boss lifecycle, rewards/progression and room soundscape.
places/main/cells/ - six authored cells span Wayside Fire, Candlehold, Broken Lantern Road and later chapter terrain; x0z0.scene holds camp and Candlehold landmarks, services and two wayshrines.
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene - Abbey/Crypt-side cell, including the Ashen Abbey wayshrine at shrine-abbey.
places/main/config.yaml - terrain, atmosphere, vegetation distributions, acoustics and 760000-byte arrival budget.
places/veil/ - ephemeral solo Lantern Shrine menu stage; hidden menu body is parked here and its cells/config/sim provide the shrine-ravine setting and ambience.
roots: world.config.yaml - world entry: main default, player/camera templates, lighting, arrival and nametag behaviors, desktop/touch actions and audio mix.
templates/player.js - Bladewraith body with humanoid-locomotion.js and scripts/player.js, plus carried-light child.
templates/camera.js - custom camera template running scripts/camera.js.
places/main/sim.js - Z01 referee for quests, NPCs, packs, progression, boss spawning/reset and soundscape.
places/main/cells/ - authored playable road and chapter terrain; scenes place landmarks, props, services and encounters.
places/veil/cells/ and places/veil/config.yaml - solo menu-stage shrine/ravine and environment; scripts/arrival.js saves an active Bearer leaving main.
shared: scripts/lib/character.js - Bearer schema, fresh state, realm roster/create/load/save/delete and packed position; player and arrival reuse it, crier and board-notes use realmOf.
scripts/db.js and scripts/lib/data/realms.yml - character and realm-bound trade schemas plus realm routing/name registry.
scripts/lib/data/economy.yml and scripts/lib/coins.js - copper denominations, drops, rewards, sell values and stock shared by sim, combat, shop, HUD and crier.
scripts/lib/data/combat.yml - hero, skill, enemy, boss, trainer and wayshrine tuning consumed by player, wax-pack, boss scripts and UI.
scripts/lib/data/loot.yml, loot-icons.yml and scripts/lib/loot.js - gear/drop/forge rules, rolls, smith ranks, boss marks, crafting and gear stats for combat, pack UI and trade.
scripts/lib/data/brews.yml and scripts/lib/brews.js - brew recipes, costs, rank scaling and active-brew helpers used by player, HUD and pack UI.
scripts/lib/data/trade.yml and scripts/lib/trade.js - realm listing/buy/unlist/collection logic shared by camp and Candlehold boards; crier and board-notes read listings.
scripts/lib/data/veilfall-map.js - chapter floor gates, areas and landmarks shared by terrain, player and main sim; includes Pilgrims' Way, Candlehold and Exchange coordinates.
notableExports: scripts/player.js - onSpawn, onInput, update; scripts/ui.js - default state-driven HUD/menu renderer; ui/nametag.js - nametag renderer.
scripts/abbess.js, bailiff.js, ringer.js, warden.js and hangman.js - boss onSpawn/update handlers.
scripts/crier.js - onSpawn, quiet, update; scripts/board-notes.js and scripts/trophies.js - update; scripts/wax-pack.js - roll, telegraph, hurtPlayers, payout, update.
scripts/gen/wayshrine.js - geometry; scripts/gen/cap-kit.js - Candlehold palette/local-frame helpers; scripts/gen/hub-trophy.js - HOOKS, geometry, collider.
scripts/lib/loot.js - gear, forge, marks, crafting and smith helpers; scripts/lib/character.js - CHAR_KEYS, fresh, START, realmOf, pack, zoneOf, roster and character persistence.
ownership: scripts/lib/character.js CHAR_KEYS - persistent Bearer fields including quest/reward claims, boss flags, inventory/gear, progression/resources, arts and attuned shrines; packed position and zone feed re-entry/menu context.

scripts/player.js - active-body movement/combat/death and skill timers, menu/options scratch, floor gates, inventory/service actions and derived gear stats; shrine proximity, current shrine, glow instances and travel request cursors are runtime state.
places/main/sim.js - per-player quest/dialog/cut progression and reward claims; enemy pack/encounter spawning, boss lifecycle, room music and ambience.
scripts/wax-pack.js - ordinary enemy AI/hp/death and eligible Bearers' XP, copper, kills, shards and gear-drop inboxes.
scripts/bailiff.js, ringer.js, warden.js, hangman.js and abbess.js - respective boss hp/phases/casts/adds/defeat, participant flags and place boss rows/lastFall.
Boss scripts - first room-wide world.state.trophies[boss] record {at, by}; scripts/trophies.js derives relic visibility, plaque/stele text and transient ring/flash dedupe.
scripts/crier.js - Brother Ledd route, pause, sale/mark/fall announcement cursors; scripts/lib/shop.js and scripts/lib/trade.js own shop/buyer mutations and realm SQL trade rows.
scripts/ui.js - renders menu, HUD and service panels from player state; scripts/player.js handles submitted UI actions.
flows: world.config.yaml attaches player through templates/player.js and maps actions; UI menu actions → scripts/player.js routes title/realm/character/create/enter/logout/options.
player.js menuInput → character.js roster/create/load/remove; realms.yml maps selected realm to room and Bearer fields hydrate player.state.
While player.state.menu is set, player.js hides the body and moves it to solo place veil; menu screens remain state-driven and that place has no characters.

scripts/ui.js reads selected roster character's zone to select the painted menu backdrop; zoneArt maps Ossuary/Bone/Crypt/Nave/Abbey names to Ossuary art, Candlehold/Pilgrim/Fire/Wayside or blank to Candlehold art, and other zones to Broken Lantern Road art.

controls.js selects menu touch surface when player/charId is absent or menu active and while shop/bag is open; otherwise world.config.yaml supplies world controls; ui.js actions return to player.js and service handlers.
player.js periodically/on rest saves changed CHAR_KEYS plus packed position → character.js writes characters; arrival.js saves an active Bearer leaving main.
player.js derives chapter floor gates from quest stage/abbeyOpenAll → veilfall-map.js floorDist governs goals and movement; Ossuary access depends on stage/open-all and Abbey/Nave access.
Main sim advances quests and spawns/resets bosses; boss defeats mark participants and write place.state.lastFall {boss, by, at} → crier heralds a fresh fall to a nearby camp listener.
Boss scripts write first room-wide world.state.trophies[boss] = {at, by} → trophies.js updates Trophy Post/Stele; ui/nametag.js marks Firstblood; crier announces falls and worn marks.

Near Wayside forge, pack-ui craft/temper/reforge/ascend → player.js + loot.js consume materials and update inventory/gear; cauldron brew actions consume recipe resources, save timed brew/renderXp and derive combat bonuses.

Near trade boards, player.js boardNear sets atBoard; UI trade actions → trade.js read/list/buy/unlist/collect realm listings, with board-ui, crier and board-notes sharing market data; trainer and other service panels similarly submit actions to player.js.

combat.yml wayshrines list IDs/coordinates, reach, toll and Abbey gate; scenes place matching stones → player.js shrineNear saves attunement in player.state.shrines and sets atShrine; ui.js offers lit destinations → travel action/player.travelInput validates gate, copper and nearby foes, then moves the body and spends the toll.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/hub-*.js - reusable Wayside Fire props varied by instance params, seed and scene transform; share hub-kit.js; hub-board.js is also Candlehold's exchange-board.
scripts/gen/vf-*.js other than vf-ruin.js - Broken Lantern Road landmarks/clutter varied by params and seeds, built with vf-kit.js.
scripts/gen/vf-ruin.js - road, arena, Wax Veil approach, ashlar, braziers and Abbey door forms selected by kind/dimensions and seed.
scripts/gen/cap-kit.js with cap-gate.js, cap-house.js and cap-wall.js - Candlehold stone, timber and slate share local-frame helpers; instance dimensions, lighting and seed vary.
scripts/gen/veil-land.js and veil-shrine.js - Veil ledge/cliff/ridge structures vary by kind/dimensions; shrine exports structure/hook constants.
scripts/gen/arena-floor.js, arena-pillar.js, gibbet.js and toll-throne.js - Bailiff arena dressing shares scripts/gen/shapes.js and its wax palette.
scripts/gen/abbey-litter.js and abbey-court.js - Abbey yard/Crypt litter and court dressing vary by kind/seed/transform; court preserves a clear local -Z door path; fen-*.js share fen-kit.js.
scripts/gen/wayshrine.js - shared stepped octagonal stone/obelisk and memory-light geometry reused by shrine-wayside, shrine-candlehold and shrine-abbey; scene transform/seed vary.
probableOrphans: scripts/gen/wax-figure.js - legacy procedural enemy-figure generator; current wax actors use CDN models.
migrationNotes: Persistent character data is scripts/lib/character.js CHAR_KEYS plus packed position; shrines is now a saved per-Bearer array, while atShrine and shrine presentation/glows are transient.

Wayshrine IDs and coordinates in scripts/lib/data/combat.yml must stay aligned with scene IDs/locations; Abbey destination also obeys the player gate. Travel costs 10 copper and refuses while an enemy is within 10 m.

The Veil is solo and ephemeral and parks the hidden menu body at its origin; camera.js menu framing is tuned to its shrine/ledge. Menu backdrop selection depends on the selected roster character's zone string and scripts/ui.js zoneArt matches.

Boss state is distinct from ordinary enemy hp: each boss publishes a place.state row and marks participants; main sim owns spawning and quest progression/reset. Boss first-fall world.state.trophies is permanent per room, distinct from per-character kill flags.
Player combat values and wayshrine travel configuration live in scripts/lib/data/combat.yml; avoid duplicating those values in handlers or UI.
